items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Frankie Lane and let's see who else ... Frankie Lane and Billy Eckstine was there.

ctx.x: You had the first house band there, didn't you?

Yes, I had the house band and we were there maybe two years, like, and this is when Louis would come in, and Nat would come in, and Lady Day would come in -- all the big acts would come. Frankie Lane and let's see who else ...
Had Eddie [Deshields] sold it by then?
